info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Trader Position Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Trader Position Operation Status API provides real-time insights into the status of trader position operations within the wholesale trading domain. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding the state of various operational processes related to trader positions. Typical consumers include traders, analysts, and support teams who require up-to-date operational data for decision-making and compliance purposes. Utilizing this API facilitates efficient monitoring and enhances operational transparency in trading activities.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of trader position operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of trader position operations within the wholesale trading system. It provides insights into the operational state, facilitating efficient tracking and management of trader positions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the status query for the trader position operations. It contains the necessary information in JSON format to retrieve the current status of trader positions.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of trader position operations.

ListTraderPositionOperationStatusRequest.description: The status of the operations in the trader position request.

tradingBookId.description: The unique identifier for the trading book.

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

side.description: The side of the operation (e.g., buy or sell).

quantity.description: The quantity of the instrument involved in the operation.

limitPrice.description: The limit price associated with the operation.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version of the operation record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update of the operation record.

ListTraderPositionOperationStatusRespons.description: Represents the response structure for the operations related to trader position.

value.description: The numerical value of the limit price.

currency.description: The currency in which the limit price is denominated.

LimitPrice.description: Represents the limit price information for a trading operation.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracking related requests.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographical region where the operation was processed.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata information related to the trading operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which involves providing a JSON Web Token (JWT) that represents the user's identity and permissions. The token should be included in the Authorization header of requests.
